This article examines the incidence of severe bleeding (alvorlig blødning) among prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation, comparing outcomes across different types of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]]. The data highlights how bleeding risks vary depending on whether patients are treated with [[doac|DOAC]], [[marevan]], a combination of both, or neither.

Among the cohorts analyzed, patients receiving a combination of both DOAC and Marevan exhibit the highest rate of severe bleeding, with 4.68% (38 patients) experiencing this adverse event [^src1]. This combination therapy stands out as a significant outlier, carrying more than double the bleeding risk of the overall patient population, which sees a 2.22% severe bleeding rate (3,136 patients) [^src1]. In contrast, the lowest incidence of severe bleeding is observed in patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, where only 1.37% (366 patients) developed severe bleeding [^src1]. 

Patients on Marevan alone show a severe bleeding rate of 2.54% (129 patients), which is slightly above the overall average [^src1]. The broader cohort on any anticoagulation therapy (AK-behandling) has a 2.40% bleeding rate (2,603 patients) [^src1]. Notably, the data row for DOAC alone is left blank in the source table, providing no specific incidence values for patients exclusively on this treatment [^src1]. Because this comparison is drawn from a single snapshot in time, no longitudinal trends regarding bleeding rates can be established.

Further details on related atrial fibrillation clinical indicators, epidemiological distributions, and healthcare quality standards are documented across the broader registry publications [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24].

## Table: AFDK_2025.pdf, p. 71

Rows compare: antikoagulationsbehandling · Columns show: antal og procent

| Alvorlig blødning | Nej | Ja |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alle | 138005 97.78 | 3136 2.22 |
| AK-behandling | 105874 97.60 | 2603 2.40 |
| DOAC |  |  |
| Marevan | 4959 97.46 | 129 2.54 |
| Både DOAC og Marevan | 774 95.32 | 38 4.68 |
| Hverken DOAC eller Marevan | 26398 98.63 | 366 1.37 |

Entities: alvorlig-bloedning, antikoagulationsbehandling, doac, marevan

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner antal og procent af prævalente patienter med atrieflimren, der udvikler alvorlig blødning, opdelt efter type af antikoagulationsbehandling, og viser højeste andel blødning blandt dem på både DOAC og Marevan.
